conditions.addition: Oleic acid and 1-adamantyl isocyanide, then 1 mL methanol

limitations: The supplement contains labeling inconsistencies in earlier tail-synthesis sections, including compound 10 under the 3-prime alcohol procedure; these are not inherited as exact L2 evidence.
The 119-23 control supports aldehyde Ugi 4CR only. It does not qualify ketone Ugi 4CR, source-bank membership of v8 products, biological labels, component synthesis, or procurement.

source_contract.architecture_policy: One primary-amine aldehyde Ugi 4CR event; preserve provider precursor tuple and lane. No ketone equivalence, source-bank assignment, experimental label, L2 or L3 admission.
source_contract.atom_origin_policy: Reuse Ugi N1/C2/C3/N4 product scaffold and Passerini acid C/O query fragments. Add acid C5=O6, bond N1-C5 and map the product amide O7 to the acid hydroxy O. This is a Mumm atom-origin convention, not isotope evidence. Aldehyde oxygen leaves in the net water inventory. No physical sequence of isolated intermediates is asserted.
source_contract.net_element_policy: Sum of four complete reactants equals product plus registry-declared water, including all hydrogens and net charge.
source_contract.query_scope: Reuse functional-group identity predicates only; the A3 transform and multiplicities are not used. The frozen Ugi transform, multiplicities and all unfiltered products remain intact.
